EDW"N V. JAVÅLUVÅS City Engineer/BuiIding Officials Pasay City Dear Engr. Javaiuyas: This refers to your request for a clarification on two issues, to wit: i. Can the Sangguniang Paniungsod create the office of the Building Official? 2. Can the City mayor appoint/designate a Building Oificiai without regard to Section 477 (a) of R.A. 7160? The request is being made in view of the perceived confijct between the opinions of NCR ARD Virgilio Castro and RD Renato Brion on issue number 2 above- stated. Thus, the oniy issue to be resolved here is query number 2, since, this office affirms the opinions issued by ARD Castro and RD Brion insofar as the first query is The second query is answered in the negative. Sec. 477 (a) (2) of RÄ 7160 or the Local Government Code of 1991 expiicitjy provides: "The appointment of an engineer shali be mandatory for the provincial, city, and municipal governments. The city and municipal engineer shaii also act as the local building official." Thus in the event the Office of the Building Officiai is created. the head thereof wili be no less than the City or Municipal Engineer as the case may be, given the mandatory statement of law that "the city and municipal engineer shall aiso act as the local building official." Thus, upon creation of the Office of the Building Official, the City or Municipal Engineer, automatically becomes the head thereof, without need of any further designation or appointment, as the law (Sec 477 (a) (2) RÄ 7160) has made said engineers the Local Building Official.
